personal.name: Emilio González
personal.about: years of experience in web application and enterprise system development. Experienced in both frontend and backend, as well as relational and non-relational databases. Currently focused on building and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Vue.js, and AWS, working with microservices and asynchronous processing to deliver scalable and highly available systems.

work.summary: Fullstack Software Engineer specialized in scalable cloud applications, with experience in microservices, APIs, and distributed systems on AWS. Working with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Vue.js, focused on high availability, concurrency, and asynchronous processing (SQS). Strong emphasis on performance, resilience, and continuous improvement.
In charge of developing new functionalities, working on the frontend, backend and database adjustments. Support in analysis and integration of new developments with external suppliers.
Provided maintenance services for websites and web applications, collaborating with different companies and helping small businesses achieve an online presence.

Part of the integrations team, assisting external clients in integrating the company's services using DLL. Leveraging my FrontEnd knowledge, I supported the development of a landing page that helped automate internal processes and improve productivity.

Developed the main landing page for one of the company's products, using Prismic to give the marketing team full autonomy over published content. Contributed to the team responsible for migrating systems from Angular 7 to newer versions of Nuxt, enhancing user experience.

Responsible for the development, maintenance, and support of external client systems. I was responsible of the development and maintenance of the company's main platform, including analysis and delivery time estimation.
